scene1 : Cinematic anime action shot, 16:9, dark fantasy aesthetic.

CHARACTER: The hooded shadow sovereign from @image1 — large pointed black hood, 
gold-trimmed collar, violet chest gemstone, calm composed posture.

SCENE: Vast moonlit plain at midnight, cracked dark earth, swirling mist, 
distant ruined towers in the silhouette background.

[0-2s] Camera: Low-angle hero shot, slow orbit around him. Action: He stands center frame, 
slowly raises his right hand palm-up. The chest gemstone flares violet. His shadow on 
the ground begins to RIPPLE and expand outward unnaturally, stretching beyond his body.

[2-5s] Camera: Top-down overhead shot, slow pull-up. Action: His shadow on the ground 
splits and multiplies into dozens, then hundreds of separate shadow pools rippling outward 
across the plain like spreading ink. Each pool starts to bulge upward.

[5-8s] Camera: Hard cut to low-angle wide shot. Action: From every shadow pool, sleek 
black wolf-like silhouettes and crow-shaped shadow creatures emerge in a violent surge, 
glowing violet eyes, wisps of dark mist trailing their bodies. Hundreds of them sprint and 
fly forward past the camera in a tidal wave, fangs and claws bared.

[8-10s] Camera: Slow push-in on his face under the hood. Action: He lowers his hand calmly, 
faint amused half-smile visible, glowing violet eyes locked forward as the swarm rushes 
past on either side of him, his coat and hood fluttering from the wind of their passing.

STYLE: Dark fantasy anime, cel-shaded, dynamic motion, deep blacks with violet glow accents, 
mist and ember particle effects, cinematic lighting, no text, no logos, no subtitles.

AUDIO: Low ominous drone, ripple-water shadow SFX, hundreds of layered growls and wing-beats, 
rising wind, single deep heartbeat thud at the end.

CHARACTER: The hooded shadow sovereign from @image1 — tall slender young man, large pointed black hood, gold-trimmed high collar, violet gemstone glowing on chest, slim longsword in right hand, faint violet aura.

SCENE: Nighttime ruined stone courtyard, broken pillars, drifting mist, cold moonlight from above, faint violet ambient glow on the ground.

[0-2s] Camera: Low-angle medium shot, slow push-in. Action: He stands perfectly still, sword held low at his right side, point grazing the ground. The hood casts shadow over his upper face, only the glowing violet eyes visible. Wind ripples his coat. A thin trail of black shadow-mist begins coiling up the blade.

[2-5s] Camera: Snap-cut to side profile, locked-off. Action: He raises the sword overhead in one fluid motion, violet energy condensing along the entire edge into a crackling blade of pure shadow-fire, the gemstone on his chest pulsing in sync. [5-8s] Camera: Hard cut to wide shot, locked-off. Action: He swings the sword down in a single explosive horizontal slash, releasing a massive crescent-shaped wave of violet-black shadow energy that arcs forward across the courtyard, splitting stone pillars cleanly in half as it passes through them. Speed-line streaks, embers, and ribbons of dark mist trail behind the wave.

[8-10s] Camera: Slow pull-back. Action: He stands in finishing pose, sword extended sideways, hood settling, while the courtyard behind splits apart in delayed collapse — pillars sliding diagonally and crumbling. Violet embers drift past the camera.

STYLE: Dark fantasy anime, hand-drawn cel-shaded, Ufotable-grade VFX, deep blacks, violet shadow-fire, gold rim-lights, cinematic depth of field, no text, no logos, no subtitles.

[9-10s] Camera: Slow pull-back wide shot. Action: He lowers his hands, stands in silhouette against the rising violet mushroom cloud in the distance, hood and coat settling, faint half-smile visible.

vuelan hacia adelante pasando la cámara en una ola, mostrando colmillos y garras.

[8-10s] Cámara: Acercamiento lento a su rostro bajo la capucha. Acción: Baja su mano con calma,

enjambre pasa a su lado, su abrigo y capucha ondeando por el viento de su paso.

scène1 : Plan d'action cinématographique d'anime, 16:9, esthétique dark fantasy.

PERSONNAGE : Le souverain de l'ombre encapuchonné de @image1 — grande capuche noire pointue, col bordé d'or, gemme violette sur la poitrine, posture calme et posée.

SCÈNE : Vaste plaine éclairée par la lune à minuit, terre sombre craquelée, brume tourbillonnante, tours en ruines lointaines en silhouette à l'arrière-plan.

[0-2s] Caméra : Plan héroïque en contre-plongée, orbite lente autour de lui. Action : Il se tient au centre du cadre, levant lentement sa main droite paume vers le haut. La gemme sur sa poitrine s'illumine en violet. Son ombre au sol commence à ONDULER et à s'étendre de manière surnaturelle, s'étirant au-delà de son corps.

[2-5s] Caméra : Plan en plongée, vue de dessus, retrait lent. Action : Son ombre au sol se divise et se multiplie en dizaines, puis en centaines de bassins d'ombre distincts ondulant à travers la plaine comme de l'encre qui se répand. Chaque bassin commence à se gonfler vers le haut.

[5-8s] Caméra : Coupe brutale à un plan large en contre-plongée. Action : De chaque bassin d'ombre, des silhouettes noires de loups élégants et des créatures en forme de corbeaux émergent dans une poussée violente, yeux brillants violets, volutes de brume sombre traînant leurs corps. Des centaines d'entre eux courent et volent vers l'avant, passant devant la caméra comme une vague déferlante, crocs et griffes à découvert.

[8-10s] Caméra : Zoom lent sur son visage sous la capuche. Action : Il abaisse calmement sa main, un léger demi-sourire amusé visible, les yeux brillants violets fixés vers l'avant alors que le nuage passe de chaque côté de lui, son manteau et sa capuche flottant au vent de leur passage.

STYLE : Anime dark fantasy, ombrage cellulaire, mouvement dynamique, noirs profonds avec accents de lueur violette, effets de particules de brume et de braises, éclairage cinématographique, pas de texte, pas de logos, pas de sous-titres.

AUDIO : Bourdonnement bas et menaçant, SFX d'ombre ondulante comme de l'eau, centaines de grognements superposés et battements d'ailes, vent montant, unique battement de cœur profond à la fin.
